{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine-knit top: fitted turtleneck, hip length, deep burgundy #7B1E3A, extra-fine merino wool

Skirt: pleated midi, A-line, mid-calf length, vivid emerald #0B7A57, satin-finish crepe

Tights: sheer, ankle length, black #1A1A1A, 20-denier nylon

Coat: long straight-cut, single-breasted, below the knee, warm cream #E8DCC8, soft wool-cashmere blend

Shoes: ankle boots, almond toe, 5 cm block heel, black #1A1A1A, smooth leather

Earrings: sculptural drop earrings, 5 cm long, gold #C9A227, polished brass

Clutch: small structured envelope clutch, black #1A1A1A, patent leather

This outfit stands out through colour rather than fuss. Emerald against burgundy is a rich, confident pairing that reads as bold under theatre foyer lighting and stays elegant. The refined knit, pleated midi skirt and ankle boots fit a neat evening look, and the satin-finish pleats catch the light as she moves. The cream coat gives a clean, bright frame for the jewel tones on a cool autumn evening, and the black tights, boots and clutch ground the colours. The gold earrings are the only shiny accent, so the look feels intentional and comfortable through a 19:00 performance."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2318,"output_tokens":1110},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
